mechanism: Bumetanide causes hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia which increase metoclopramide's risk of tardive dyskinesia and QT prolongation; metoclopramide may worsen electrolyte depletion.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) regularly; consider potassium-sparing agent or supplementation; assess for metoclopramide-induced movement disorders.
